:::{#thm-entropy-discrete}
#### Entropy of a discrete random variable

Let $X$ be a [discrete random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-discrete-rv) with [probability mass function](random-variables.qmd#def-pmf) $\P(X=x)$.
Then

$$\entropyf{X} = -\sum_{x \in \rangef{X}} \P(X=x) \log \P(X=x).$$

A term with $\P(X=x) = 0$ is taken to be $0$,
because $p \log p \to 0$ as $p \to 0$.

:::

::: proof

Let $g(x) \eqdef \surprisalf{x} = -\log \P(X=x)$, which is finite for each value $x$ with $\P(X=x) > 0$.
Then [LOTUS](#thm-lotus) gives

$$
\ba
\entropyf{X}
&= \E{\surprisalf{X}} && \text{(definition of entropy)} \\
&= \E{g(X)} && \text{(definition of } g \text{)} \\
&= \sum_{x \in \rangef{X}} g(x) \cd \P(X=x) && \text{(LOTUS)} \\
&= -\sum_{x \in \rangef{X}} \P(X=x) \log \P(X=x). && \text{(definition of } g \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
